title: Page 7
content_zh:
“安静安静！在这儿，谁也别想比我大声！”郑奇山拍着桌子囔囔。
“今天找大家来，没别的，先弄清楚一件事儿。昨晚福晋说老王爷在世时跟你们订了十年之约，是否属实？”
众人你看我、我看你，一个胆子较大的看初荷没吭声，率先发难。
“这么久的事情谁还记得！十年十年，算算也是三十年前的事，现在要怎么讲都行。倘若这女人要说咱欠王府银两，那咱到底认还是不认？”说罢，众人又起哄抗议，初荷却始终保持沉默，只是以黑白分明的眼睛看着郑奇山如何发落。
“安静安静！我刚不是说了不准大声？谁敢再造次就掌嘴！”郑奇山拍着桌子，顿时公堂又安静下来。
“福晋，你说老王爷答应发给大家月例，可只有十年期限，这件事情可有什么凭据吗？”
初荷看了众人一眼，这才以略为低弱的嗓音说着：“我这儿有一张老王爷亲笔所写的条子，上头还有在场好几位老人家按的手印，大人您是否先过目？”
此话一出，众人皆愕然，显然全没料到事隔三十年，竟还找得到这样的东西。
初荷让林管家将纸条递上。她昨晚才要去歇息，就接到郑奇山派人来传话，要她找出任何证据才好服众。其实她老早就在颁布停止发放月例之前就已经找到老王爷亲笔所写的字条，只是昨晚尚无机会拿出来。
“来，大家过来看看，这上头分明就写得一清二楚，你们这几个老人家想必记性变差，怎么全都给忘了？这可真是不应该啊。”郑奇山招手叫几个老人过来看。
“怎么样？你们要是心有不服，要不另外按个手印让我比对比对？”
几个老人自讨没趣的扯扯嘴角，不讲话。郑奇山看这态势，也知道这几个人分明就记得这事儿，只是老王爷一死，欺负福晋年幼，这才死不认账。
“那好，这有凭据的大家也没话说。福晋，我来替这些老人家说几句话，瞧他们大约生活艰难，一时半刻没法儿自给自足，你可有什么两全其美的办法吗？”郑奇山问着。
初荷点头，命林管家将带来的一箱物品
“这里按照每户人口发放，最多五十两，足够做点小生意，同时也可租借王府田地耕种为生。愿意拿的人就在此按手印，保证日后再无二话。”初荷声音虽微弱，却极是清晰。
这是她昨晚听到郑奇山的人传话之后才匆忙准备的。想想这可真是万全之计，让她不由得佩服赞叹；只是，敬佩之余也不免怀疑，郑奇山看来就是个胆大粗犷之人，心思怎会如此细腻？
想着，她不由自主的抚着受伤的手臂。昨晚看见那瓶药膏，内心的疑惑逐渐加深。药膏瓶身的模样她曾在皇太后那儿见过，分明就是皇宫里的物品，郑奇山只是一个偏远地区的穷县令，怎可能拿出这般物品？
“此法子甚好。同意的人就过去拿钱按手印，往后就不准再来闹事，否则就得偿还两倍银两，也不准再用王府田地耕种，当然本大人也不会轻放。”
“那要是不按手印呢？”昨晚砍伤初荷的带头者挑衅反问。
郑奇山脸色一冷。“不按，当然也不能勉强，那就自己找诉讼师来告啊，等打赢官司再来说吧。”

那人一提气，正要发作，郑奇山却忽然重重拍桌子大喝。
“昨晚就是你拿刀伤人对吧？本官还没拿你问罪，你带刀伤人，难道眼里没有王法吗 ？”
那人看情势不对，顿时脸色惨白。
“大人，倘若宗亲们各个都愿意拿钱按手印，初荷也不想追究昨晚的事了。”初荷表明。
公堂之上众人面面相觑，几个老人摸摸鼻子率先过去按手印，接着，其他人也都凑过去，毕竟，有钱那总比吃官司好。
直到所有人一一领了银两、按了手印，公堂上只剩下初荷、林管家以及郑奇山。
“多谢郑大人相助。”初荷露出有些虚弱的笑容。
郑奇山起身走到堂下。“福晋伤势如何？昨晚我家母亲送到府上的药膏，有拿来涂抹吗？”
初荷点头。“擦了那瓶药，伤口愈合极快，早上就觉得好多了。”
“那就好。”
初荷看着他，略为思索后开口：“郑大人，您最近是否曾跟兰泗贝勒碰面？”
郑奇山一惊，却故作镇定。“自从那次驿站一别，就没再见过啦，福晋怎会这么问呢？”
“因为那瓶药看来似皇宫之物。”初荷追问，目不转睛的看着郑奇山。
郑奇山眼睛一转，“呵呵，福晋好眼力，那药其实是之前兰泗送给我娘的物品；既是兰泗所赠，就有可能从皇宫拿出来的吧。”
所幸昨晚，兰泗曾经提醒他初荷极有可能认出瓶身乃出自皇宫，因此特别要他这么扯谎。好险！幸好兰泗心思细腻过人，凡事都要先斟酌推敲过。
不过，这么聪明的人怎么无法处理自己的儿女私情呢？
初荷垂下眼帘，心里泛起的竟是失落与伤怀；她以为自己逃得远远的就没事了，可竟然还是如此轻易受到波动。不，梅花林那日相见之后，她的情绪可说是更容易起伏，任何细微小事都让她惆怅，任何琐事都容易让她联想到他。
“福晋想打听兰泗贝勒的消息吗？”郑奇山故意问。
初荷苍白的脸泛起尴尬。“没有，我只是随口问问。”
看来昨晚看见小总管，大概也是她一时闪神吧。

“听说兰泗贝勒拒绝蒙古公主的亲事，让圣上非常恼火。”郑奇山一派轻松的说着。“还听说他已经禀明皇太后婚配对象，对方是个皇族的遗孀，结果引起众人震惊，礼亲王一气之下把他打个半死，好几天都不能下床。”
初荷惊讶的看向他。“你说的是真的吗？”
“当然是真的，这都是我在京城的朋友说的。”才怪！他在京城根本只认识兰泗而已，不过管他的，有时扯扯谎还真是挺有趣。
“怎么会这样……”初荷惨白着脸，她没想到兰泗真的跑去跟皇太后禀明，一想起兰泗可能遭受的责难，就觉得难受极了。
“兰泗婚配的对象跟你一样，不知道你在北京时是否听过，到底是谁啊？”郑奇山承认自己有点坏心眼，但他实在看不下去这两人别扭的行径。照他的做法，有什么说什么，然后合则聚，不合则散，这样不是简单多了吗！
初荷摇头，显现难得一见的慌张。“我不知道！”
“我随口问问而已 。”郑奇山摸摸鼻子。
“今日之事既已办妥，初荷也要回府了，再次感谢大人相助。”
她欠了欠身，拖着伤臂缓缓离开，林管家跟在后头护送。
直到初荷的身影完全消失，公堂后方才传来不满的声音。
“你这人怎么老爱胡扯。”
兰泗不甚高兴的从后面走出来。“你这么说，不是让她无法安心养伤吗？”
方才在后头看见初荷那副憔悴虚弱、连说话都没有力气的模样，让他难受极了。
“我就是故意要这样说说，让她知道你的苦处。你虽没我刚才说的凄惨，但也差不了多少。看看你这趟成了什么模样，再这样下去，你也别住我家里了，我可不想替你收尸。”郑奇山实在看不下去他失魂落魄的模样。
兰泗半响才又开后；“初荷一向聪明，她方才让你给骗了，只因一时心神不宁，等她回府细细思索蛛丝马迹，大约就会猜到我的确是在你这儿，到时，你就算没赶我走，她也会想办法逼我离开。”
content_en:
"Quiet, quiet! No one here can be louder than me!" Zheng Qishan slapped the table and muttered.
"I'm here to see you all today. If nothing else, I want to clarify one thing first. Last night, Fujin said that the old prince made a ten-year agreement with you when he was still alive. Is that true?"
Everyone looked at me and I looked at you. The bolder one looked at Chu He without saying a word and took the lead in attacking.
"Who can remember something that happened so long ago! Ten years, ten years, even if you think it was thirty years ago, you can say whatever you want now. If this woman wants to say that I owe the prince some money, do we admit it or not?" After that, everyone started to protest again, but Chu He remained silent, just watching Zheng Qishan's frustration with black and white eyes.
"Quiet, quiet! Didn't I just say not to speak loudly? Whoever dares to do it again will be slapped!" Zheng Qishan slapped the table, and the court suddenly became quiet again.
"Fu Jin, you said that the old prince promised to give everyone a monthly routine, but it was only for ten years. Is there any evidence for this?"
Chu He glanced at everyone, and then said in a slightly lower voice: "I have a note here written by the old prince himself. It also has the fingerprints of several elderly people present. Sir, would you like to take a look at it first?"
As soon as these words came out, everyone was stunned, obviously they didn't expect to find such a thing thirty years later.
Chu He asked Butler Lin to hand over the note. She was just going to rest last night when she received a message from Zheng Qishan, asking her to find any evidence to convince the public. In fact, she had found the note written by the old prince long before the monthly cessation of distribution was announced, but she had no chance to take it out last night.
"Come on, everyone, come and take a look. It's clearly written here. You old people must have bad memory, so why have you forgotten everything? This is really not the case." Zheng Qishan waved to several old people to come over and take a look.
"How about it? If you are dissatisfied, why don't you take another fingerprint and let me compare it?"
Several old people twitched their lips in annoyance and did not speak. Seeing this situation, Zheng Qishan also knew that these people clearly remembered this incident, but they refused to admit it because they bullied Fujin when the old prince died.
"Well, everyone who has proof has nothing to say. Fujin, let me say a few words for these elderly people. It seems that their lives are difficult and they cannot be self-sufficient for a while. Do you have any way to get the best of both worlds?" Zheng Qishan asked.
Chu He nodded and ordered Butler Lin to bring a box of items.
"The distribution here is based on the population of each household, with a maximum of fifty taels, which is enough to do some small business, and at the same time, you can rent the palace's fields to cultivate for a living. Those who are willing to take it can put their fingerprints here and guarantee that they will never talk to each other again in the future." Although Chu He's voice was weak, it was extremely clear.
This was prepared in a hurry after she heard the message from Zheng Qishan's people last night. Thinking about it, this was really a foolproof plan, and she couldn't help but admire her. However, while admiring her, she couldn't help but doubt. Zheng Qishan seemed to be a bold and rough man, so how could he have such a delicate mind?
Thinking about it, she couldn't help stroking her injured arm. When I saw the bottle of ointment last night, my doubts gradually deepened. She had seen the ointment bottle from the Empress Dowager before. It was clearly an item from the palace. Zheng Qishan was just a poor county magistrate in a remote area. How could he come up with such an item?
"This method is very good. Those who agree can go over and take the money and have their fingerprints pressed. They are not allowed to make trouble again in the future. Otherwise, they will have to pay twice the amount of silver and they will not be allowed to use the palace's fields for farming. Of course, I will not let it go lightly."
"What if we don't press the fingerprints?" the leader who stabbed Chu He last night asked provocatively.
Zheng Qishan's face turned cold. "If you don't press it, of course you can't force it. Then you can find a litigator to sue yourself. Let's wait until you win the lawsuit."
The man got angry and was about to explode, but Zheng Qishan suddenly slammed the table and shouted.
"You were the one who hurt someone with a knife last night, right? I haven't brought you to trial yet, but you brought a knife to hurt someone. How could it be so?"Is there no king's law in Tao's eyes? "
The man saw that something was wrong with the situation, and his face suddenly turned pale.
"Sir, if all the clan members are willing to pay for their fingerprints, Chuhe won't want to pursue what happened last night. "Chu He said.
Everyone in the courtroom looked at each other. A few old people touched their noses and took the lead to press their fingerprints. Then, everyone else came over. After all, having money is better than having to go to court.
Until everyone received the money one by one and pressed their fingerprints, only Chu He, Butler Lin and Zheng Qishan were left in the courtroom.
"Thank you, Master Zheng, for your help. "Chu He showed a weak smile.
Zheng Qishan stood up and walked down the hall. "How is Fujin's injury? Did you apply the ointment my mother sent to your house last night? "
Chu He nodded. “After applying that bottle of medicine, the wound healed very quickly, and I felt much better in the morning. "
"That's good. "
Chu He looked at him, thought for a moment and then said: "Master Zheng, have you met Lan Sibeile recently? "
Zheng Qishan was shocked, but pretended to be calm. "We haven't seen each other since we said goodbye at the inn. How could Fujin ask this? "
"Because that bottle of medicine looks like something from the royal palace. Chu He asked, looking at Zheng Qishan intently.
Zheng Qishan rolled his eyes, "Haha, Fujin has good eyesight. That medicine was actually something Lan Si gave to my mother before; since it was a gift from Lan Si, it was probably taken from the palace. "
Fortunately, last night, Lan Si had reminded him that Chu He most likely recognized that the bottle came from the palace, so he especially asked him to lie like this. What a risk! Fortunately, Lan Si has a very delicate mind and must consider everything first.
However, how come such a smart person cannot handle the personal relationship between his children?
Chu He lowered her eyes, feeling loss and sadness in her heart; she thought she would be fine if she escaped far away, but she was still so easily affected. No, after meeting in Meihualin that day, her mood could be said to fluctuate more easily. Every little thing made her melancholy, and every trivial thing easily reminded her of him.
"Does Fujin want to know about Lan Sibeile? "Zheng Qishan asked deliberately.
Chuhe's pale face was filled with embarrassment. "No, I was just asking casually. "
It seems that when she saw the young manager last night, she was probably in a flash of consciousness.
"I heard that Lansi Beile refused the marriage of the Mongolian princess, which made the Holy Emperor very angry. "Zheng Qishan said in a relaxed tone. "I also heard that he had informed the Empress Dowager of his marriage partner, who was a widow of a royal family. As a result, everyone was shocked. Prince Li beat him half to death in anger, and he couldn't get out of bed for several days. "
Chu He looked at him in surprise. "Is what you said true? "
“Of course it’s true, this is what my friends in Beijing said. "That's weird! He only knows Lan Si in the capital, but what the heck, lying is really fun sometimes.
"How could this happen..." Chu He's face turned pale. She didn't expect that Lan Si would actually go and tell the Empress Dowager. She felt extremely uncomfortable when she thought of the possible blame that Lan Si would suffer.
"Lan Si is marrying the same person as you. I wonder if you heard about it when you were in Beijing. Who is it? "Zheng Qishan admitted that he was a bit evil-minded, but he really couldn't stand the awkward behavior of these two people. According to his approach, say what you have to say, and then get together when they get along, and break up when they don't get along. Isn't this much simpler!
Chu He shook his head, showing a rare panic. "I don't know! "
"I'm just asking casually. "Zheng Qishan touched his nose.
"Now that today's matters have been taken care of, Chuhe will return home. Thank you again for your help. "
She bowed and left slowly, dragging her injured arm, with Butler Lin following behind to escort her.
It wasn't until Chu He's figure completely disappeared that dissatisfied voices came from the back of the courtroom.
"Why do you always talk nonsense? "
Lan Si came out from behind unhappily. "When you say that, doesn't it make her unable to rest in peace and recover from her injuries? "
Just now I saw Chu He's haggard and weak look from behind.The lack of energy to speak made him feel extremely uncomfortable.
"I just wanted to say this on purpose to let her know your plight. Although you are not as miserable as I just said, you are not much different. Look what you have become this time. If this continues, you will no longer live in my house. I don't want to collect your body for you." Zheng Qishan really couldn't bear to see his lost look.
Lan Si opened the door again after a while, "Chu He has always been smart. She was deceived by you just now because she was restless for a moment. When she returns home and thinks carefully about the clues, she will probably guess that I am indeed here with you. By then, even if you don't drive me away, she will find a way to force me to leave."
